title: Severe performance issues, freezes constantly
body: I've relied on Microsoft To Do for years, but the iOS app consistently suffers from severe memory leaks and freezing issues, regardless of the iPhone model or iOS version. It regularly slows down, becomes unresponsive, and sometimes completely freezes my phone, forcing restarts. Despite updates and reinstallations, the issue persists. It's disappointing that such a critical productivity app from Microsoft remains so unreliable.

title: Group to-do lists and report
body: I have been using this app for a while, and I'm satisfied because it keeps me make clearer and better decision before starting my days. I have two suggestions about this app. First, I want the ability to group to-do lists. It will be great if I can organize related lists in a group or folder, and when I want to delete, I just delete the specific folder. Second, the report of how many percentage I've completed in a specific time. It can be a week, month or year. I'm waiting for the update. Thanks 😊😊
